raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`DeepSeekV32Detector` (`deepseekv32`, and its `deepseekv4` / `deepseekv41` subclasses) scans model output with two lazy `open(.*?)close` patterns that go quadratic when the closing tag never arrives:

1. `detect_and_parse` runs `re.findall(<｜DSML｜function_calls>(.*?)</｜DSML｜function_calls>)`. With many opening tags and no closing one, each opening tag rescans to the end of the text.
2. `_parse_parameters_from_xml` runs `re.finditer` with `<｜DSML｜parameter ...>(.*?)</｜DSML｜parameter>` over the invoke body. A closed invoke holding many unclosed parameter tags rescans the body from each one, both in `detect_and_parse` and in a single `parse_streaming_increment` call.

| Input | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| 184 KB of unclosed `<｜DSML｜function_calls>`, non-stream | 23.7 s | 0.3 ms |
| closed invoke with 8000 unclosed parameter tags (352 KB), non-stream | 48 s | 33 ms |
| same, **one streaming call** | 49 s | 21 ms |

Tool-call parsing runs synchronously on the tokenizer manager's event loop, so one such response stalls every in-flight request. Found with an Atheris fuzzing harness that records per-input parse time.

## Modifications

Both scans are bounded with `endpos` = the end of the last closing tag. No match can end past it. Every opening tag before it still finds its closer (and the match consumes everything up to that closer), while opening tags after it never could match. So the matches are unchanged and the total scan is linear.

Regression test `test_unclosed_tags_parse_in_linear_time` in `test_deepseekv4_detector.py`: 41.3 s on `main`, fast here.

## Accuracy Tests

- Differential test of `main` vs patched detectors for all three variants, comparing `detect_and_parse` and every streaming result under random re-chunking: **0 mismatches** over 60k random plus 60k mutated well-formed inputs (about 12.5k per variant produced parsed calls).
- `test/registered/unit/function_call/`: 630 passed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

See the table above. A scaling probe (each token literal and each pair, repeated 2k/4k/8k times) finds no remaining super-linear input.

Related: #42573, #42574, #42575 (same issue class in other tool-call parsers).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (N/A)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch:
@@ -86,6 +86,7 @@ def __init__(self):
         self.eot_token = f"</{block}>"
         self.invoke_start_token = f"<{invoke}"
         self.invoke_end_token = f"</{invoke}>"
+        self.parameter_end_token = f"</{parameter}>"
         self.parameter_regex = (
             rf'<{parameter}\s+name="([^"]+)"\s+string="([^"]+)"\s*>(.*?)</{parameter}>'
         )
@@ -100,6 +101,13 @@ def __init__(self):
         )
         self.current_tool_id = -1
 
+    @staticmethod
+    def _end_of_last(text: str, token: str) -> int:
+        # No match can end past the last closing tag; scanning only up to it stops
+        # each unclosed opening tag from rescanning to the end (quadratic).
+        idx = text.rfind(token)
+        return 0 if idx == -1 else idx + len(token)
+
     def has_tool_call(self, text: str) -> bool:
         """Check if the text contains a deepseek v32 format tool call."""
         return self.bot_token in text or self.invoke_start_token in text
@@ -152,7 +160,11 @@ def _parse_parameters_from_xml(self, invoke_content: str) -> str:
         parameters = {}
         # Find all complete parameter matches
         param_matches = list(
-            re.finditer(self.parameter_regex, invoke_content, re.DOTALL)
+            re.compile(self.parameter_regex, re.DOTALL).finditer(
+                invoke_content,
+                0,
+                self._end_of_last(invoke_content, self.parameter_end_token),
+            )
         )
 
         # Stray prose around the parameter tags is ignored, as before. Leftover
@@ -203,7 +215,9 @@ def detect_and_parse(self, text: str, tools: list[Tool]) -> StreamingParseResult
         idx = text.find(self.bot_token)
         if idx != -1:
             normal_text = text[:idx].removesuffix("\n\n")
-            sections = re.findall(self.function_calls_regex, text, re.DOTALL)
+            sections = re.compile(self.function_calls_regex, re.DOTALL).findall(
+                text, 0, self._end_of_last(text, self.eot_token)
+            )
         else:
             # The streaming path accepts bare invokes without the outer
             # wrapper; parse them here too instead of leaking raw DSML.

@@ -1,5 +1,6 @@
 """Unit tests for DeepSeekV32Detector DSML streaming — no server, no model loading."""
 
+import time
 import unittest
 from unittest.mock import patch
 
@@ -397,6 +398,34 @@ def test_non_streaming_parses_every_function_calls_section(self):
 
         self.assertEqual(len(result.calls), 2)
 
+    def test_unclosed_tags_parse_in_linear_time(self):
+        """Many unclosed function_calls or parameter tags must not stall the parser
+        (it runs on the event loop); the complete call before them survives."""
+        unclosed_params = _wrapped(
+            _invoke(
+                "get_weather",
+                _param("city", "true", "x")[: -len(f"</{DSML}parameter>")] * 6000,
+            )
+        )
+        unclosed_sections = f"<{DSML}function_calls> " * 6000
+
+        start = time.perf_counter()
+        result = DeepSeekV32Detector().detect_and_parse(
+            _weather_call("SF") + unclosed_sections, self.tools
+        )
+        _, calls = self._feed([_weather_call("SF") + unclosed_params])
+        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
+
+        self.assertLess(elapsed, 1.0)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [(call.name, call.parameters) for call in result.calls],
+            [("get_weather", '{"city": "SF"}')],
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [(call.name, call.parameters) for call in calls],
+            [("get_weather", '{"city": "SF"}')],
+        )
+
     def test_unexpected_parse_error_fails_closed(self):
         """An unexpected parse error keeps the prose, drops the DSML and the
         call, and the dropped buffer must not come back on the next delta."""
